def make_df():
    return IamDataFrame(
        pd.DataFrame(
            [["m", "s", "World", "Primary Energy", "EJ/yr", 1.0, 6.0]],
            columns=["model", "scenario", "region", "variable", "unit", 2005, 2010],
        )
    )


def write(tmp_path, text):
    f = tmp_path / "val.yaml"
    f.write_text(text)
    return f


def run(tmp_path, text):
    v = DataValidator.from_file(write(tmp_path, text))
    return v.apply(make_df())


def test_warning_does_not_raise_bounds(tmp_path, caplog):
    with caplog.at_level(logging.DEBUG):
        out = run(
            tmp_path,
            "- variable: Primary Energy\n  year: 2010\n  upper_bound: 5\n"
            "  warning_level: low\n",
        )
    assert isinstance(out, IamDataFrame)
    assert any(r.levelno == logging.WARNING for r in caplog.records)
    assert not any(r.levelno >= logging.ERROR for r in caplog.records)


def test_warning_does_not_raise_value(tmp_path):
    out = run(
        tmp_path,
        "- variable: Primary Energy\n  year: 2010\n  value: 1\n  rtol: 0.1\n"
        "  warning_level: low\n",
    )
    assert out.equals(make_df())


def test_without_warning_level_still_raises(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Data validation failed"):
        run(tmp_path, "- variable: Primary Energy\n  year: 2010\n  upper_bound: 5\n")


def test_mixed_error_and_warning_raises(tmp_path, caplog):
    text = (
        "- variable: Primary Energy\n  year: 2010\n  upper_bound: 5\n"
        "  warning_level: low\n"
        "- variable: Primary Energy\n  year: 2005\n  lower_bound: 2\n"
    )
    with caplog.at_level(logging.DEBUG):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Data validation failed"):
            run(tmp_path, text)
    assert any(r.levelno == logging.WARNING for r in caplog.records)

            "  warning_level: low\n",

import os

import pytest

from gita import info, common


def _git(path, *args):
    subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=path, check=True, capture_output=True)


@pytest.fixture
def repo(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "r"
    p.mkdir()
    _git(str(p), "init", "-q")
    _git(str(p), "config", "user.email", "a@b.c")
    _git(str(p), "config", "user.name", "n")
    (p / "f").write_text("a")
    _git(str(p), "add", "f")
    _git(str(p), "commit", "-q", "-m", "m")
    return str(p)


def _status(repo, cfgdir):
    with mock.patch.object(common, "get_config_dir", return_value=str(cfgdir)):
        return info.get_repo_status({"path": repo, "type": "", "flags": []}, no_colors=True)


def test_default_dirty_symbol(repo, tmp_path):
    (open(os.path.join(repo, "f"), "w")).write("changed")
    out = _status(repo, tmp_path)
    assert "*" in out


def test_custom_dirty_symbol(repo, tmp_path):
    open(os.path.join(repo, "f"), "w").write("changed")
    (tmp_path / "symbols.csv").write_text("dirty,D\n")
    out = _status(repo, tmp_path)
    assert "D" in out
    assert "*" not in out


def test_custom_untracked_symbol(repo, tmp_path):
    open(os.path.join(repo, "new"), "w").write("x")
    (tmp_path / "symbols.csv").write_text("untracked,U\n")
    out = _status(repo, tmp_path)
    assert "U" in out
    assert "_" not in out.replace("_", "", 0) or "U" in out


def test_custom_staged_symbol(repo, tmp_path):
    open(os.path.join(repo, "f"), "w").write("changed2")
    _git(repo, "add", "f")
    (tmp_path / "symbols.csv").write_text("staged,S\n")
    out = _status(repo, tmp_path)
    assert "S" in out
    assert "+" not in out


def test_clean_has_no_symbols(repo, tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "symbols.csv").write_text("dirty,D\nstaged,S\nuntracked,U\n")
    out = _status(repo, tmp_path)
    assert "D" not in out and "S" not in out and "U" not in out
